dedupe_keys.name: crc san andres submarine cable sait capacity monitoring colombia

description: This CRC dataset monitors the submarine cable that links the island of San Andrés to Tolú on the Colombian mainland, operated by Energía Integral Andina (EIA) and regulated under CRC Resolution 3776 of 2012. It reports, each quarter from 2013, the transmission capacity installed at interface level, the capacity in use by each operator (for example Claro, Movistar, Solcable Visión and MinTIC) in STM-1 units and Mbps, the capacity still available, the share of commercial capacity contracted, and the agreements made with operators; in the first quarter of 2013 about 1,431 Mbps remained available. A dashboard on Postdata shows the series. Coverage: the San Andrés to Tolú cable. Format and access: CSV download with preview, metadata in DCAT formats and a dashboard, free; no specific licence is stated. Caveats: only one cable; capacity figures are as reported by the operator and in STM-1 units that need conversion. Simulation uses: a real example of an island depending on a single submarine cable, for studies of cable failure, spare capacity and the value of redundancy such as satellite backup. Related records: the TeleGeography submarine cable map gives global routes, and the Postdata record covers the rest of the CRC's data.
licence: not stated on the dataset ('Licencia no especificada'); Postdata terms: free access to public data without restriction
